chapter: Arriving in New York: the Nest Club and Harlem nightlife
title: A Constant Sinner closes after bad reviews
summary: The show ran two weeks on the road and two on Broadway, and Mae West's earlier shows were controversial and raided.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: So the show lasted what, two weeks on the road and two weeks on Broadway. Then it closed, because they had bad reviews. That was one of the first racial... And Mae West had been on Broadway two or three times before. All her shows were way ahead of their time, controversial. And one
time they raided the whole show, took all the actors to jail, because they were doing something on the stage... We have to check that out.
